func TestLoadEnvironmentVariableReferences(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
	err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`log:
  level: "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_LEVEL}"
  encoding: "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_ENCODING}"
server:
  http_port: "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_HTTP_PORT}"
  grpc_port: "${_FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_GRPC_PORT_9}"
cache:
  ttl: "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_CACHE_TTL}"
`), 0o600)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	t.Run("substitutes multiple values before decoding their types", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_GRPC_PORT", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CACHE_TTL", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
		t.Setenv("_FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_GRPC_PORT_9", "9292")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_CACHE_TTL", "45s")

		result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
		assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
		assert.Equal(t, 8181, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
		assert.Equal(t, 9292, result.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
		assert.Equal(t, 45*time.Second, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
	})

	t.Run("corresponding environment variables take precedence", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
		t.Setenv("_FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_GRPC_PORT_9", "9292")

		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8383")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_GRPC_PORT", "")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CACHE_TTL", "")

		require.NoError(t, err)

		assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingConsole, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
		assert.Equal(t, 8383, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
		assert.Equal(t, 9292, result.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
		assert.Equal(t, 45*time.Second, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
	})
}

func TestDecodeHooksEnvironmentVariableReferences(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE", "replacement")
	t.Setenv("_FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE_9", "underscore replacement")
	t.Setenv("9FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE", "invalid name replacement")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT-CONFIG-TEST-REFERENCE", "invalid character replacement")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_EMPTY_REFERENCE", "")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_MISSING_REFERENCE", "")
	require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_MISSING_REFERENCE"))

	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		input any
		want  any
	}{
		{"starts with a letter", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", "replacement"},
		{"starts with an underscore and contains a digit", "${_FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE_9}", "underscore replacement"},
		{"prefix", "prefix${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", "prefix${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
		{"suffix", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}suffix", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}suffix"},
		{"two references", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
		{"digit first", "${9FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", "${9FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
		{"invalid character", "${FLIPT-CONFIG-TEST-REFERENCE}", "${FLIPT-CONFIG-TEST-REFERENCE}"},
		{"empty environment variable", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_EMPTY_REFERENCE}", ""},
		{"missing environment variable", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_MISSING_REFERENCE}", "${FLIPT_CONFIG_TEST_MISSING_REFERENCE}"},
		{"integer input", 123, 123},
		{"boolean input", true, true},
	}

	hook := mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(DecodeHooks...)
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(hook, reflect.ValueOf(tt.input), reflect.Zero(reflect.TypeOf("")))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
		})
	}
}
